facts.text: AST is elevated more than 2 times the upper limit of normal.
notes: concept set by the rule files: ast -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The most recent AST before the decision time is 130 IU/L (2110-11-30 23:49), and an earlier value was 197 IU/L (R2/R3); both exceed twice the typical AST upper limit of normal (~40 IU/L), so the records show AST elevated more than 2x ULN.
